sourceChecks.text: The days which Jeroboam reigned were twenty two years; then he slept with his fathers, and Nadab his son reigned in his place.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah; and he reigned over Israel two years.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha struck him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel were besieging Gibbethon.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文の明示名と前後文脈を確認。

sourceChecks.text: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
